text:
Anna K: FYI release pipeline is red on main -> candidate. Looks like a dependency lockfile race during the gradle publish step, artifacts failing to upload.
ci-runner: build #482 failed on step 'publish-artifacts'. Error: 409 Conflict when writing to gcs://redwood-artifacts/gradle-cache. Hash mismatch reported by remote.
Anna K: copy of the failure log below:
ci-runner: ```
> Task :publishToMavenLocal FAILED
Caused by: java.io.IOException: Failed to upload file: PUT https://storage.googleapis.com/redwood-artifacts/gradlesnapshots/commons-1.2.0.jar -> 409 Conflict (ClientError)
Checksum mismatch: expected sha256=abcd1234 got sha256=efgh5678
``` 
Mike L: ugh, saw intermittent 409s last week when two runners tried to push the same SNAPSHOT concurrently. Could be the new parallel publish change in gradle-plugin 3.4.0.
Sophia R: which PR introduced the plugin bump? @James T did the infra PR yesterday, right?
James T: yes that was #2894 — bumped gradle-publish-plugin 3.3.1 -> 3.4.0 to speed up uploads. I tested locally but not under concurrent runners.
Anna K: deploy-bot posted that the release job is blocked: deploy-bot: "Deployment blocked: candidate/2026-03-20 - CI failing (publish-artifacts)"
deploy-bot: `Status: blocked | Blocking tests: publish-artifacts (2 failures)`
Mike L: options:
• revert plugin bump and re-run CI
• pin plugin to 3.3.1 in the publish job until we investigate
• add a mutex around the publish step (serialize uploads)
Sophia R: I'm leaning to pin and serialize for the short term. Reverting infra PR will be noisier for other changes.
Oliver P: agreed. Pinning + single-run mutex in CI should be fast. I can send a hotfix PR to the pipeline config.
James T: I can roll a quick patch: set GRADLE_PUBLISH_PLUGIN=3.3.1 in the release pipeline and add `--no-parallel` to the publish command. Want me to push to release-ops-hotfix?
Anna K: do it. Also we should clear the remote partial uploads so next run doesn't hit the same checksum collision.
Mike L: I'll run a GCS cleanup script to remove any objects with timestamp in the last hour under gradlesnapshots/ and re-run staging.
ci-runner: queued rebuild #483 (triggered by James T).
Anna K: action items: James -> hotfix PR to pin plugin + no-parallel; Mike -> cleanup remote objects; Oliver -> monitor next run and be ready to rollback release tag if still failing.
James T: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/2901 (pipeline pin + no-parallel). Can someone review quickly?
Oliver P: LGTM, merging now.
ci-runner: build #483 started.
ci-runner: build #483 finished: publish-artifacts step succeeded. No more checksum errors.
Anna K: great. We still need a follow-up: create a test that runs concurrent publishers in our CI sandbox to catch this, and consider an atomic publish mechanism in the gradle plugin.
Sophia R: noted. I'll file an engineering task and add it to the next sprint.
Mike L: we should also add a postmortem blurb in release notes: short explanation + mitigation.
Anna K: agreed. For today's release: proceed with canary rollout at 15:30 UTC, but hold full rollout pending 1-hour watch.
deploy-bot: Canary rollout scheduled: candidate/2026-03-20 -> canary (15:30 UTC). Watch window: 1h.
James T: thanks everyone. Closing the blocker for now. :thumbsup:
